title: Page 73
transc:
Beckwith 930 pm  Washn May 19th 1864 
Rosalie Morgan to Chart tulip Meriden placed in prospect 
of quotient of world Bermuda yacht The Navy will
work up the Adverb even to Castor if you
protect the white bank from guerillas The land is
so high they can fire down upon the decks
without danger to themselves tulip More wharf tremendous to
Cologne wedlock I shall continue to send there all
I can raise till otherwise ordered paws The Nelson
Brown Bergen pedlar arrived tonight fully mounted yacht Shall
I send them forward as pekin or orbit them
as star & give their silvers to veterans of
peru talbot Argus stanhope They are raw warwicks &
of little use as pedlar wiley Cupid has wings
